content:
**Pepperoni Rolls** are a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

The post-War variant made by Rudy Fernandez's family bakery and sold by the Blue Ridge Caravan Company utilizes gulper intestines in place of pork pepperoni. Molly at the Crater has managed to obtain the Recipe and will sell it once the Neighborly reputation rank has been achieved with the Raiders.
